applicability_reason: Project metadata indicates subcontractors will be used, so DelDOT 108.1 subletting limits apply.
draft_location: General_Conditions.pdf, p1, lines 21-22 (section "Contract subletting")
draft_evidence: Subcontracting. Up to eighty percent (80%) of the work may be subcontracted without Department approval, and the prime is not responsible for subcontractor performance.
reference_location: DelDOT Standard Specifications, Section 108.1 (CC-14), paragraphs A and E
reference_evidence: The reference requires the prime to perform no less than 50% of the total original contract price with its own organization (108.1.A); subletting requires the engineer's written consent and does not relieve the prime of its contract responsibility (108.1.E).
explanation: The package clause contains two affirmative conflicts with the reference. First, it raises the permissible subcontracting ceiling from 50% to 80% ('Up to eighty percent (80%) of the work may be subcontracted'), directly contradicting the 108.1.A requirement that the prime perform no less than 50% of the total original contract price with its own organization. Second, it negates the prime's continuing responsibility by stating 'the prime is not responsible for subcontractor performance,' directly contradicting 108.1.E, which provides that written consent 'does not relieve the contractor its responsibility to fulfill the contract requirements.' Additionally, the clause states work may be subcontracted 'without Department approval,' negating the written-consent prerequisite in 108.1.E. No addendum revises this provision; Addendum A makes no changes, and Addenda B and C address unrelated provisions. Both deviations are material and provable by direct quotation. Human review and correction are strongly recommended.
recommended_human_action: Review and correct the subcontracting clause in General_Conditions.pdf. The 80% ceiling must be reduced to conform to the 50% self-performance floor in DelDOT 108.1.A; the disclaimer of prime responsibility must be removed to conform to 108.1.E; and the 'without Department approval' language must be removed to restore the written-consent requirement. Recommend legal/contract administration review before execution.

No addendum revises this provision — Addendum A makes no changes, Addendum B revises only the change-notification clause, and Addendum C revises only the bonds clause. This is a material deviation: an invented flat daily rate applied universally in place of the schedule-based rate required by Section 108.9. Human review and correction are recommended.
recommended_human_action: Review and correct the liquidated damages clause in Special_Provisions.pdf to align with the tiered rate schedule in DelDOT Section 108.9, Table 108.9-1, based on the awarded contract value.
